purpose: Define a bounded local generative intelligence contract without hosted models, network dependence or autonomous authority.
central_claim: Generative intelligence means producing novel, bounded and verifiable compositions from typed observations, local memory, rules and context; fluent unsupported text is not sufficient.
non_claims: not physical latency or energy evidence

pipeline.input: typed query and bounded local catalog
pipeline.output: typed evidence set with generations and provenance

pipeline.input: facts, rules, evidence and bounded budget
pipeline.output: proof, contradiction, abduction, limit or abstention

pipeline.input: verified components and an explicit composition plan
pipeline.output: novel typed candidate with derivation graph
accepted presentation, qualified proposal or abstention
bounded local text or haptic frame

pipeline.input: human physical gesture and purpose-bound session
pipeline.output: separate authority decision owned by existing policy gates

systematic_composition.definition: Known components must combine correctly in unseen legal arrangements.

grounded_continuity.definition: A generated claim must identify the local evidence, rule or explicit hypothetical source that supports it.

temporal_personalization.definition: The system must use current generations while preserving superseded history and refusing stale or revoked evidence.

counterfactual_reasoning.definition: Hypothetical composition must remain explicitly hypothetical and cannot alter durable state or authority.

bounded_planning.definition: Plans are finite typed candidates; no plan step is execution and every consequential step carries a confirmation requirement.

dialogue_continuity.definition: The response remains coherent with the active local semantic state without retaining forbidden raw interaction data.

selective_generation.definition: The system may refuse, qualify or ask for clarification when query answerability, evidence, confidence or policy is insufficient.

comparison_policy: Only identical inputs, frozen splits, identical output contracts and versioned scoring code may support a release comparison. No external LLM score is imported into a HERUS release claim.

research_basis.claim: Systematic generalization must be measured with controlled distribution shifts and novel component arrangements.
Compositional skill requires both systematicity and flexibility rather than rigid symbolic correctness alone.
Correct-looking retrieved generation can still contain unsupported sentences, so groundedness must be measured separately.
Abstention should account for query answerability, model confidence and human-value constraints.
